thread:
carla_support: Hi team — urgent DPA erasure for customer ACME Inc (EU). Legal needs proof of complete deletion and KMS/HSM evidence for keys used on their data. Customer gave request id 0xAB12 and says they called DELETE /v1/objects/{id} yesterday but still see embeddings in their app. Can we confirm deletion + provide audit trail? cc @emma_legal :rotating_light:

nathan_oncall: Thanks, Carla. Can you paste the customer org id and the example object id they deleted? Also, which region (eu-west-1?)

carla_support: Org: org-acme-9, object id: obj-7f3b21. They said region was eu-west-1. They want a time-stamped proof for contractual DPA obligations — specifically: (1) confirmation that object data and derived embeddings were removed, (2) KMS key usage logs around the deletion, and (3) confirmation of any cache/replica cleanup.

lia_infra: On it. Quick notes: our delete workflow is asynchronous: DELETE triggers tombstone, then garbage-collection job (GC) sweeps KV store and triggers embedding invalidation and optional blob removal. KMS: we do envelope encryption; HSM logs only show key usage; key material not deleted on object deletion. We can pull audit logs for the key operations and GC run logs. Need the approximate deletion timestamp from customer to narrow query.

carla_support: Customer claims they performed deletion at 2026-03-12T15:34:20Z (their clock). I asked for server-side timestamp but they wanted immediate proof so escalating.

emma_legal: Please compile a compliance artifact with redacted PII. The artifact should include: timeline of server-side events (delete request received, GC start, GC complete), KMS API calls (Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey — list with timestamps), and any replica purge confirmations. We prefer a signed export (S3 link with short TTL). Lia, can infra provide logs and a short statement we can attach?

lia_infra: Yes. I will query our audit-index and KMS audit export. Steps I'm going to run now: 1) query http-logs for DELETE /v1/objects/obj-7f3b21 around 2026-03-12T15:00-16:00Z, 2) check gc-run logs for job id that touched that object, 3) pull KMS key activity for key alias/rw-org-acme-9 in same window, 4) check embedding-cache invalidation events. Will paste artifacts (redacted) here. Need elevated creds to export S3 package — @nathan_oncall can you run with me?

nathan_oncall: I can help. Share the exact query strings and I'll run in the secure ops session. Also, we should confirm data residency semantics: if replicas existed in a secondary region, we need to include those purge confirmations. Carla, did customer say anything about multi-region replication?

carla_support: They said app runs in eu-west-1 only. No obvious cross-region.

ops_bot: Automated run started by nathan_oncall: ops-export --query "http.method:DELETE AND http.path:/v1/objects/obj-7f3b21" --from 2026-03-12T14:50:00Z --to 2026-03-12T16:10:00Z --out /tmp/exports/1845673210/http-delete.json

ops_bot: KMS audit request queued: kms-audit --key-alias rw-org-acme-9 --from 2026-03-12T14:50:00Z --to 2026-03-12T16:10:00Z --format csv --out /tmp/exports/1845673210/kms-activity.csv

lia_infra: I'm running GC lookup: gc-query --object obj-7f3b21 --range 2026-03-12T00:00:00Z..2026-03-13T00:00:00Z

nathan_oncall: I pulled http-delete.json, here's the relevant snippet:

```
{
  "timestamp": "2026-03-12T15:34:27Z",
  "method": "DELETE",
  "path": "/v1/objects/obj-7f3b21",
  "status": 202,
  "request_id": "req-9b2c"
}
```

nathan_oncall: GC job references: job-id gc-1149 touched obj-7f3b21 at 2026-03-12T15:34:58Z, status: queued -> processing -> completed (2026-03-12T15:35:11Z).

lia_infra: KMS activity for alias rw-org-acme-9 in that window: records show GenerateDataKey at 2026-03-12T15:33:50Z (used for upload), and Decrypt at 2026-03-12T15:34:26Z (delete path validated). No calls to ScheduleKeyDeletion or key material rotation at deletion time (we don't rotate per-object). I will export the CSV and redact request IDs.

emma_legal: That sounds fine. For the compliance artifact: include the exact server-side timestamps (UTC), the GC job id and its completion timestamp, and the KMS audit lines. Add a one-paragraph signed statement: "Based on our system logs, the object and associated derived embeddings were removed from primary storage and embedding caches on 2026-03-12T15:35:11Z. No cross-region replicas were found for org-acme-9. KMS key alias rw-org-acme-9 was used for data key operations but key material was not destroyed as part of object deletion." Lia, can you produce that and upload to a pre-signed S3 link (48h)? Mark the zip as compliance-export-acme-0xAB12.zip.

lia_infra: Will do. Uploading redacted artifacts now. Pre-signed URL created: https://s3.redwood-inference.test/compliance/exports/compliance-export-acme-0xAB12.zip?X-TTL=48h (internal link).

carla_support: Sending link to customer legal. Emma, do you want me to use the wording you suggested or attach your signed paragraph as-is?

emma_legal: Use the exact paragraph I wrote. I'll sign the statement (GPG) and attach signature file inside the zip. Also add a short chain-of-custody note: who pulled logs, who redacted, who uploaded.

nathan_oncall: I also validated cache invalidation: embedding-cache logs show invalidation event for obj-7f3b21 at 2026-03-12T15:35:05Z. Adding that line to exports.

carla_support: Thanks everyone. Customer replied: "Received. Reviewing. Please include the KMS CSV with headers and the signed statement." I added a follow-up asking for confirmation when they accept the artifact. :white_check_mark:

lia_infra: Export zip contains: http-delete.json (redacted), kms-activity.csv (redacted request ids), gc-job-log.txt, cache-invalidation.json, compliance-statement.txt, compliance-statement.txt.sig, chain-of-custody.txt.

carla_support: Filing closure notes on the ticket and attaching the S3 link + short summary. Will reopen if legal asks for deeper HSM attestation. Closing thread for now. :v:
